title: Tamarind House
description:
Tamarind House will seduce you with its tranquillity and its breathtaking views. You will love its simplicity and authentic environment. A breezy balcony allows you to relax and enjoy the sea, garden and village views.

Guest access
Self-contained apartment including a kitchenette, a big sleeping room with office and table, a simple bathroom and a balcony with breathtaking views.

Other things to note
The apartment is suitable for couples, solo travellers and families with one older child. The apartment is not suited for small children or people who cannot manage stairs.

The apartment will be cleaned after every three days and a cook can be organised for some little extra.

title: Rob apartment
description:
A specious one bedroom apartment with a private kitchen, bathroom and living room seven minutes walk from Peponi and two minutes to Banana House.

The romantic upper terrace is shared and looks over the roof tops of Shela to the sea and there are two girls who clean everyday and will do laundry which is included.

Ceiling fans and window breezes cool the apartment. Please bring the shampoo and soaps you prefer. We look forward to hosting you…!
Please let me know arrival time one day before

The space
It feels home

Guest access
Shared terrace

Other things to note
Stay at my place and everything you need to know and help through me

title: Artist’s Loft on Lamu Main Street, Old Town
description: Set along Usita wa Mui, the main street of Lamu Old Town, this flat is the first project of a graduate architect and artist (the host himself). Housed in a 700-year-old Swahili home, it combines history, craftsmanship, and art. The space doubles as a working studio and small gallery with mixed-media works. Facing the lively street, it carries the hum of daily life and stories below — a true immersion into the spirit and creativity of Lamu.

title: Tamarind House 1st Floor
description: Cozy space with three comfortable beds: two in the bedroom and one on the veranda, perfect for enjoying the fresh air! Ideal for groups or families looking for a relaxing getaway.

title: Andavelo House Luxurious Suite
description:
Andavelo House is a centuries old beautifully recently restored six-suite patrician house set in the old town of Lamu, Kenya. Andavelo House has nearly 800 m2 with beatifully appointed custom made furniture in all the suites and common areas.

Our house is fully staffed. Daily cleaning and basic amenities are provided. Breakfast and meal cooking services are provided at a fee upon request.

Our staff can assist you with booking a dhow or provide you information on any local attractions.

The space
We book individual suites that fit two persons. If additional guests come, they would need to book additional suites.

All suites have their own fully equipped bathroom and have chill out areas and several of them sea view terraces.

We have a swimming pool available for guests and an extensive common areas both by the pool and on the terrace over looking the town, sea and nearby Manda island

Guest access
Guests can access all common spaces including roof top terrace, swimming pool and chill out areas around the house

Other things to note
Pick up and return to airport is offered upon request

title: Star House 4
description: Relax in this charming 1-bedroom apartment in the heart of Shela, Lamu. Enjoy an open kitchen and dining area that flows onto a private terrace (Baraza) — perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach. It has access to Makuti rooftop terrace with benches and cozy swing bed. Simple, airy, and authentic Swahili style for a peaceful stay.

title: Bedroom 2 Saba House and Artist Residency
description:
Welcome to the Saba Artist Residency, a tranquil hideaway in the heart of Lamu. Just a 10-minute walk from the ocean, our home is surrounded by sea breezes, golden dunes, lush plantations, and traditional island homes.
Designed as both a guest house and artist retreat, it carries the warmth of a lived-in home rather than a hotel. Artworks from past residents invite you to rest, reflect, and connect with creativity and the land take it easy at this unique and tranquil getaway.

The space
Set in Lamu on an old two-acre coconut farm, our property is one of the few in the area with such a large garden. Here, guests can enjoy peace, serenity, and a genuine connection to nature. As part of your welcome, we share fresh coconuts and coconut water from the farm, complimentary during your stay.

At the heart of the property is our small fruit farm, where mangoes, coconuts (madafu), and organic greens grow in rhythm with the seasons. Guests are welcome to enjoy what’s freshly picked — whether it’s a sweet mango in the afternoon or a glass of tender madafu under the shade.

The house was originally designed as both a guest house and an artist residency, giving it the warmth and authenticity of a home rather than the formality of a hotel. Around the house, you’ll discover artworks from past resident artists, inviting you to live among creativity, contemplate, and enjoy the unique atmosphere.

The design embraces open spaces with several living rooms, shaded verandas, and a swimming pool — perfect for relaxing, gathering, or simply enjoying the natural light and coastal breezes.

Each bedroom has its own character and views of the garden or compound, and all are bright, cozy, and clean with a private toilet and shower:
• Master Bedroom: bathtub, fans, and air conditioning.
• Bedroom 2: fans and air conditioning.
• Bedroom 3: fans only, enhancing its unique charm.

Guest access
Upon arrival at Manda Airport, you can either:
• Board a public boat (KES 400 per trip), or
• Arrange a private boat through us (KES 1,500 per trip).

Please communicate with Yusuf (caretaker & driver) or Jennifer (live-in manager) in advance so we can coordinate the best option for you.

For your arrival, simply ask the boat to drop you at the hospital jetty, where our dune buggy will be waiting to collect you and your luggage. Airport pickup and drop-off are complimentary.

Additional details:
• Boat trips to other locations on the island can be arranged; charges depend on destination.
• Dune buggy trips are strictly to Lamu town or Shela to facilitate access to restaurants in Shela and available at
KES 600 round trip. An account will be kept of trips during your stay for easy settlement.

Other things to note
✨ Guest Experience
• On-site Team
• Jennifer (Live-in Manager) will welcome you on arrival and is available throughout your stay to assist with all requests, housekeeping coordination, and ensuring your comfort.
• Yusuf (Caretaker & Driver) helps maintain the property and is available to assist with transport needs, including airport transfers and local errands.
• Meals
We have a talented local chef available at KES 2,000 per session.
• Ingredient Sourcing: Our team can source ingredients on your behalf, tailored to your dietary preferences, and deliver them directly to the house for the chef to prepare.
• Market Experience: For guests who enjoy shopping locally, we can provide a map and guidance to nearby markets so you can source items yourself.
Please request meal service in advance so the team can coordinate smoothly.
• Transfers
Airport pickup and drop-off can be arranged on request with Yusuf (rates depend on location). Please let us know if you’d like a seamless arrival.
• Children
Children are warmly welcome. Cots are available on request, subject to confirmation.
• Check-in / Check-out
• Check-in: from 2:00 pm
• Check-out: by 11:00 am
Flexible arrangements may be possible depending on availability — just ask.

⸻

🏡 House Rules
• Inviting Friends
Guests are welcome to invite a friend or two to visit during the day.
• If visiting friends would like to swim, there’s a KES 500 charge for pickup and drop-off, plus a KES 750 cover charge which includes use of a pool bed and towel.
• We’re adding two more pool beds for December, so everyone can relax comfortably.
• Overnight Guests
Overnight stays for visitors are not included in standard bookings. If a guest intends to stay the night, please communicate with management in advance so we can make proper arrangements and ensure your experience is smooth.
• Cancellation Policy
• Up to 30 days before arrival: full refund.
• 29–15 days before arrival: 30% penalty.
• 14–3 days before arrival: 50% penalty.
• Less than 2 days / no-show: 100% penalty.
(This policy aligns with Airbnb’s system for fairness and clarity.

title: The Sand Dunes!
description:
The breathtaking Sand Dunes is built with details that calm the eyes, mind & spirit. We are excited to offer this unique & tranquil getaway. Our Stunning 3 bedroom With AC home has all amenities needed for a short or long term getaway. We overlook the beautiful Shella dunes surrounded by palm trees that sway seemlessly with the birds morning songs. Your staff will handle all cleaning needs and caretaker meets you at seafront. A chef can join for a small fee &Boat transfers can be arranged.

The space
We are location in the back of the village where palm trees meet the Majestic Dunes. Sunrise and Sunset views are truly a spectacular way to start and end your days with us.
Our home is open and breezy with the kindest staff who look forward to make your stay memorable. We have added air conditioners as a cooling option for those hot summer nights. Our spacious rooms and beds guarantee a relaxing sleep and our deep pool is the best spot to cool down and we ask families to ALWAYS supervise their children around the pool and terrace for safety .karibu sana

Guest access
There are 2 doors to enter the property which will always have a staff member to greet and welcome you home.

Other things to note
Kindly we ask guests to make sure you release the hooks from windows if you are closing them or they easily break.
We do recommend though to have windows open for the breeze and sounds of swaying palms.
We do not have hot water in our home as shella naturally warms up the water with it' s sunshine and hope this is ok with you.
We ask families to kindly be at the pool with their children as there is no lifeguard and our pool is deep. karibu.

title: Maua House, palm  garden and private pool
description:
Set on the idyllic island of Lamu, Maua House is a stunning villa located in Shela, 8 minutes away from the beach.
The villa, attached to the owner’s villa, within a private luxury estate, is designed for an exclusive and tranquil stay.
Spread over 2 floors, the house is influenced by Swahili architecture, with a modern twist, built to the highest standards. It features a private swimming pool in a cool and shady garden, surrounded by nature, breathtaking majestic acacias and fluffy palm trees.

The space
The house, always offered exclusively, is thoughtfully designed to accommodate up to 4 guests, with two bedrooms.
Not suitable for children or infants. Guests aged 10 and above are welcome.
Every detail is crafted for comfort, privacy, and a connection to the lush surroundings, from airy interiors to garden-view balconies.
Thick walls downstairs and open aspects on all sides, ground floor and first floor, ensure that the house is particularly cool and breezy throughout.

The chef Martin, the steward Patrick and the gardener/pool attendant Baraka will welcome you.
For the 3 staff members, tips are appreciated.
A suggested amount is KES 1,000 per guest per day.

ON THE GROUND FLOOR:
The accommodation includes a high-ceilinged private entrance hall, with a guest restroom.
The living room has a direct access to the garden and the pool, a terrace and 4 daybeds .
The dining room looks out on the magical garden and features a large table that seats eight guests.

We ask that the guests make their own food arrangements in consultation with the chef following their arrival at the house. The kitchen is the chef's domain. Discuss your meal preferences with our chef, who will take care of planning, shopping and preparing your meals.
Provide funds to the chef (cash or via MPESA) for purchasing ingredients and beverages. Cost of living is extremely reasonable, local fish and sea food caught daily at reasonable prices.

ON THE FIRST FLOOR:
A lounge separates the two bedrooms, offering a peaceful space to unwind.
Each bedroom accommodates two guests, featuring kingsize bed (180 X 200 cm), wardrobe, en-suite bathroom with shower and toilet, a safe, an individual private balcony overlooking the gardens, the pool and the trees full of birds.
The bedrooms are designed with magnificent details of Swahili architecture and furnished with reading lights, mosquito nets, ceiling fans and designer’s chairs.
The bathrooms are adapted to delight the most discerning travelers.

Guest access
The compound is shared with the owner, most of the time travelling for her perfume company.
Maua House is divided in two parts, with a private entrance door and entrance hall on south side for the guests, on north side for the owner.
We assured that you will have a total privacy in the house and a full private access to the pool throughout your stay.

Other things to note
In Shela Village, you can walk and swim at the long pristine beach and practice water sport.
You can enjoy different restaurants located on the waterfront, go for a shopping tour in some refined and surprising fashion and decoration shops.
Shela is a great location to book dhow trips across Lamu archipelago, snorkeling adventure, tour through the Old Lamu town..

A day trip around the Lamu Archipelago (including fresh seafood grilled onboard) or a sunset sail through the mangroves on a traditional swahili sail boat, a dhow, is a must-try experience. Captain Nawaf Athman, a well-known captain in Shela, can organize and guide you on any trip around the islands with the dhow Jae’l.

Sunset sail:
sailing in the channel along the mangrove of Manda island, swim, have a drink and celebrate the beauty of a sunset in Lamu.
Takwa:
visit of the ruins on Manda island, after walking on a wooden bridge overlooking the mangrove.
Kinyka:
a small coral island on the coral barrier, where you can enjoy snorkeling, with the chance of seeing dolphins and whales – season permitting.
Manda Toto:
snorkeling along the coral barrier, with the currant, and for lunch, tasting a fresh red snapper grilled onboard with chapati and mango.
Kipungani:
from Shela, you can walk 3-4 hours to Kipungani, located at the end of the beach, have lunch onboard and come back with the dhow.
Kiwayu:
an amazing wild untouched island. Two days with a dhow. One day with a speed boat.

For water sports such as water-skiing and wakeboarding, Captain Nawaf Athman is an experienced driver and instructor who will ensure a memorable adventure.

Yin Yoga in house.
The Yoga Hall is on the ground floor, with 3 arches overlooking the garden.
Monday-Wednesday-Friday / 5:00-6:15pm / KES 1,500 / class

We can organize Massage, Chakra Activation Sessions at the house, with Makiko, an Ayurveda Therapist.

On Manda Island, in a wooden house under a centuries-old baobab, you can experiment a Gong Bath, a gateway experience, with Marcella, a Sound Healer.

This is not an exhaustive list, many more activities and places are to be discovered on site!

title: Sea view room at Ndege Beach House with pool
description:
Our house is a small boutique hotel with a swimming pool on a pristine beach. The house is very stylishly decorated with a mix of modern and African art. You can enjoy the view on a beach bed at the front or relax on a bed by the pool. We have multiple lounge areas, seating and dining areas and terraces. Enjoy the stars, the sun, the moon, the sea and the wind barefoot. This is truly home away from home! Our warm staff takes good care of the guests.

The space
A real beach house. Furnished with attention to detail and style. Enjoy this small boutique hotel, where you can unwind with the sound of the rippling sea and the many beautiful birds that Manda hosts.

Guest access
All common areas downstairs, beach beds and sun beds, pool bar and pool, massage room.

During your stay
Call or WhatsApp, or just a conversation. I am basically always present, unless I am on the road with a medical camp. But then I always have Starlink with me.

Other things to note
Boat transfers are not included. Give us your flight number and arrival time, and we will pick you up in our own boat. We charge 1,500 Ksh euros for a one-way trip. From Lamu Town it also costs 1,500 Ksh and to Shela is 500 Ksh.

We have a chef in the house so cooking ourselves in our kitchen is not the intention.

We live on the beach with beautiful birds; loud music on tree boxes or parties is not appreciated by us.

The house is really for lovers of peace and relaxation!

title: Serene Coastal Hideaway Penthouse
description:
Escape to this stunning Swahili-style penthouse, a serene hideaway perched above Shella Village. Designed with natural makuti roofing, coral-stone walls, and handcrafted wooden details, this space offers an authentic coastal charm blended with modern comfort, creating the perfect setting for relaxation, reading, or unwinding after a day at the beach.
Ideal for couples, seeking something truly unique, this penthouse combines Lamu’s rich architecture with a cosy, home-like atmosphere.

title: HEMED apartment
description:
It has two bedrooms and both are self contained only one bedroom with hot water
Aslo a living room between the two bedrooms which is private
There is also house service which are done daily and also laundry
Note the main terrace is shared
Also there is a shared kitchen in the building’s ground floor
It is perfect for two friends
Please once you are booked let me know arrival time one day before
Thank you

The space
Private living room

Other things to note
Only one room has hot water
And there is no kitchen
Also is perfect for two friends

Orange Room at 
Ndege Beach House with pool

The space
The orange room is beautifully decorated with an ensuite bathroom. There is a private terrace and views over the garden and our beautiful pool. The house is on the beach and has various sitting and dining areas. Enjoy all the beautiful places and the outdoors.
You can dine on the beach under the stars or inside the house, which is completely open. Just like in a hotel, you share the common areas. We have beach beds with views over the beach and sea and Shela. The house is stylishly decorated and developed with a lot of attention by ourselves. Come and enjoy bare foot living!

Guest access
All common areas downstairs, swimming pool, pool bar, dining room, living room, front garden with beach beds and massage room.

Call or WhatsApp, or just a conversation. I am basically always present, unless I am on the road with a medical camp. But then I always have Starlink with me.

title: Small family house in Shela
description:
Kahindi takes care of laundry, shopping, cooking and more. He stays at the ground floor and has been helping out since the house was built.

There is a Starlink Internet connection dedicated to the house. Please ask Kahindi for details.

The space
The main space on the 2nd floor almost always gets some breeze. This is where we spend most of our time, where we eat and relax on sofas or mattresses. This floor has a gate that can be closed for toddler security. Putting a few harder pillows together will also prevent toddlers from trying to get to the rooftop.

The kitchen is just next to the dining area. It has a gas cooker, a fridge/ freezer, blender, toaster and all cooking utensils required.

There is one bedroom on each floor and they are more or less identical. 6x7 feet bed, adjacent bathroom with shower, shelves and hangers.

The main space on the first floor has a desk, two daybeds and an additional smaller bed suitable for older children or an adult.

The rooftop now features a lounge with a minimal ocean view.

There are plenty of books (most in Swedish, some in English), children's toys and toddlers chair for eating. There is also a toddler bed that can be placed under the mosquito net in any of the two bedrooms.

Guest access
Guests have access to everything except a small store on the 1st floor (and the ground floor apartment with a separate entrance where Kahindi stays).

Other things to note
There is no dedicated hot water in the house but the water heats up during the day and is perfect for the after-beach shower before sunset.

Boat transfers to and from the airport are not included but we can arrange a boat for you. It's 1500KES for up to 3 ppl and 2000KES 4 and above . Price is for airport pickup only. You can arrange a return boat with the captain or Kahindi.

title: Stunning 360° View from Roof Top Terrace
description:
If you need more than one room, pls. see my other listing "Complete House" or
"Suite with private balcony"
THIS LISTING: 1 bedroom on first floor with access to roof top terrace.
The house is located in 2nd line to the seafront , overlooking the channel between Lamu and Manda Island and is within the UNESCO WORLD HERITAGE SITE. Easy to reach restaurants, shops, the market, boats and beaches.

The space
The interiors are roomy and beautifully-finished, and furnished with attractive, newly-built traditional furniture including chairs, tables, sofas, four-poster beds, planters chairs.
Thick walls downstairs and open aspects on all sides on the upper floors ensure that the house is particularly cool and breezy throughout.
The accommodation includes a high-ceilinged entrance hall, three bedrooms, three bathrooms, kitchen and dining room with balcony, spacious living room and balcony with sea view and the large makuti-thatched roof top terrace which is a lovely, romantic place on to relax, enjoy the sea breezes and watch the passing parade of dhows in the Lamu Channel.
All beds are provided with a mosquito net and ceiling fan. Sheets and towels are included. (Please bring your own beachtowels)
Allocation of beds:
1 bedroom on 1st floor (size: 180 x 200 cm)
1 bedroom on 2nd floor (size: 180 x 200 cm)
1 bedroom on 2nd floor (size: 150 x 190 cm)
There is one bathroom on every floor.
The housekeeper Katana will support you and is a pool of information.
Arrangements can be made such as chef or child care.

Guest access
The place to be is the roof top terrace!
Enjoy the view! Watch the passing dhows, the marabous...and the breeze....

During your stay
Katana will pick you up from the airport and will be your housekeeper. His room is on ground floor. Katana is in charge for service and security. He prepares your breakfast and does your shopping, will support you to find your way around, arranges your dhow trips, and will give you a helping hand.

title: Star House 3
description: Relax in this charming 1-bedroom apartment in the heart of Shela, Lamu. Enjoy an open kitchen and dining area that flows onto a private terrace (Baraza) — perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach. Simple, airy, and authentic Swahili style for a peaceful stay.

title: Single room. Private WC. Balcony. Makuti. Garden
description: Comfortable single room in first floor of private house. Self contained WC, with balcony over the main street. Common areas in the makuti area: Outdoor kitchen, dining tables and a coach, besides the garden. 50m from the sea, it has a view over the Lamu Channel. Secure area at night due to location and lighting. In the main street. Discreet, comfortable and practical. The garden gives sensation of being in an oasis within town, and green coolnes. There is also a common rooftop terrace.

title: Jamala House
description:
Jamala House is centrally located near Lamu Fort in the historic oldest part of Lamu.

It is a quiet and private resort with a relaxing garden rebuilt to a high standard and reopened in 2018.

All rooms have private baths with hot water.


Jamala features a common kitchen, seating area and a rooftop with a great view of the sea.

A continental breakfast can be enjoyed in the breakfast area.

Sightseeing tours are available close to the property and dhow services can be arranged at a fair rate.

title: shela greentreehouse seaview terrace  freewifi
description:
If you are looking for an AMAZING seaview from your own terrace in a well-furnished serviced, daily cleaned and healthy house, surrounded by green trees in a quiet and elegant corner of the beautiful Shela coast, just 2 minutes walk from shela beach,shops, bars and restaurants, you found it ! A
maid takes care of the cleaning, shopping, ironing and washing in the morning hours. Upon request, we can arrange massages and dinners at home , pick up at the airport and sailing trip on our dhow Tailan

The space
A WONDERFUL sea view ,breeze blowing throughout the beautiful terrace, colonial furniture and Italian fabrics: that's what makes this place unique! A lovely house with a big
"baraza" on the terrace to sit and relax in the shade of the big tree that gives the name to the house. The house is located on the first and second floor, comes with a kitchen, 3 bedrooms, 3 ensuite bathrooms with shower, a big terrace on the second floor and a balcony on the first floor .The big terrace is where you will be spending most of your time, for sure.
There you'll find a big dining table, some comfortable lounge chairs overlooking the sea , an antique Swahili sofa and a "baraza", a typical Swahili sitting area (this is our favourite place of the house!). The house is located in between peponi hotel and kijani hotel and it s only 2 minutes walk from the beach

Guest access
The whole house

Other things to note
One of the best-kept secrets of Africa, the island of Lamu, and in particular the village of Shela, is THE place to be if you want to relax, walk on the shela beaches and dunes , playing yoga classes at banana hotel or swim in the clean warm waters of Lamu, everything within only a few minutes from the house.The housekeeper will be available ,from 8am to 12am with daily cleaning (included), washing clothes and ironing (included) and preparing breakfast ( included ). Upon request and for an extra fee to be paid directly to the waitress , she can prepare and serve lunch and dinner.A massage therapist and beautician can be called for you for some pampering. Beds have mosquito nets, there are fans in the bedrooms.
NO AC is available.
The house has hot water and FREE WIFI
Anything else you need, just ask. There might be power shortages on the island at times. We do not use a generator but have candles available. Bigger nearby hotels (Peponi and kijani) use a generator and free wifi so you could go there to charge your devices if needed 🌺

title: Swahili Dreams Apartments number 3
description:
Welcome to our exquisite Swahili-style apartment, thoughtfully designed to provide a captivating experience for our esteemed guests. This spacious unit boasts one generously sized bedrooms, accompanied by its own ensuite bathroom, ensuring both comfort and convenience. There is also an additional decent sized bed in the main room. All the common areas, such as the indoor swimming pool, are easily accessible for our guests. We eagerly anticipate the pleasure of your visit in the near future!

Other things to note
All the common areas, such as the indoor swimming pool, are easily accessible for our guests. To make your stay as comfortable as possible, two dedicated staff members are always on hand to assist with any needs you may have. We eagerly anticipate the pleasure of your visit in the future!

title: Liv’s bedroom

title: Andavelo House Deluxe Suite
description:
Andavelo House is a centuries old beautifully recently restored six-suite patrician house set in the old town of Lamu, Kenya. Andavelo House has nearly 800 m2 with beatifully appointed custom made furniture in all the suites and common areas.

The space
House can be rented in full or per room. Current listing price reflects per suite price. Each suite fits two people in a very large custom made super King bed size.

Let us know if you have additional guests and we can discuss accommodation alternatives

Guest access
Fully staffed house which will be cleaned daily. The staff are wonderful cooks and all meals can be prepared upon request.

We recommend to include breakfast. Let us know if interested upon making the reservation.

Other things to note
Plenty of activities in Lamu including kite surfing, sailing, scuba and snorkel, turtle hatch watching and general beach chill out

title: Fully Furnished 2 Bedroom Apartment in Shela, Lamu
description: Sai Shanti House apartment is on the first floor of a private house, with its own entrance. Solar power avoids outages. The dining/sitting room overlooks the impressive sand dunes, skirting the magnificent 12 km beach. The apartment is under 8 minutes' walk to the beach and famous Peponi Hotel, on the veranda of which you can sit and watch the dhows pass. Among activities to enjoy; swimming, dhow sailing, walking the beach, visiting the historic sites of the island or lazing with a good book.

title: Swahili Paradise w/ Private Chef | Steps to Beach
description:
Welcome to a place where the rhythm of the ocean sets the pace.

As our guests consistently say, staying here is an experience in "pure paradise." Kinjarling is more than just a beautiful Swahili-style home—it's a fully-serviced retreat designed for ultimate relaxation, with our incredible staff and private chef ready to make your stay unforgettable.

Just a one-minute stroll from the pristine sands of Shela Beach and right behind the legendary Peponi Hotel, our location is simply perfect.

The space
Our home is a breezy, light-filled sanctuary that blends traditional Swahili design with modern comfort. From the cool, white-plaster walls to the intricately carved wooden furniture, every space is crafted for you to unwind, connect, and soak in the coastal beauty.

-> FOUR EN-SUITE BEDROOMS: Four spacious and serene bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom, comfortable beds, and high-quality mosquito nets. Fall asleep to the gentle sounds of the village.

-> STUNNING OCEAN VIEWS: Wake up and gaze out of the large windows at the turquoise waters of the Indian Ocean.

-> ROOFTOP TERRACE: Your personal haven. Lounge on the iconic hanging bed, enjoy sundowners with panoramic views of the ocean and village, or simply find a moment of peace under the vast African sky.

-> COMFORTABLE LOUNGING: The airy living and dining areas are perfect for sharing meals, playing games, or relaxing with a book after a day of exploring.

Guest access
You will have exclusive and private access to the entire four-bedroom house, including the rooftop terrace and all living areas. This is your home in Lamu.

Other things to note
Your Effortless Shela Experience

We are dedicated to making your trip seamless and memorable from start to finish.

-> PRIVATE CHEF SERVICE: Your stay includes the incredible services of our chef. We will happily coordinate with you on meal preferences. You will only be responsible for the cost of the groceries, which we can help procure for you.

★ The Private Chef Experience ★

One of the most beloved features of Kinjarling House is your personal chef, George. His service is included in your nightly rate, offering a truly luxurious and personalized culinary journey.

• Your Menu, Your Way: There is no set menu. Chef George will prepare all meals based on your personal requests and preferences.

• Dietary Needs: All dietary restrictions and preferences (vegetarian, gluten-free, allergies, etc.) can be happily accommodated.

• Fresh Local Ingredients: You simply provide the funds for groceries. For a truly authentic experience, you are welcome to join George on a trip to the bustling local market to select fresh seafood, spices, and produce for your meals.

------------------------------------------------

-> CONCIERGE SERVICES: As our guests love, Millicent is delighted to help arrange your airport boat transfer from Manda Island, book a magical sunset dhow cruise, organize a guided tour of historic Lamu Town, or arrange snorkeling trips. Just ask!

★ An Insider's Guide to Shela ★

As our guest, you get access to our curated list of local contacts and recommendations to help you experience the very best of Lamu.

• Our Trusted Partners: Millicent can connect you with our most trusted and reliable contacts, including our two boat captains for magical sunset sails and a highly knowledgeable guide for an enriching tour of historic Lamu Town and its culture.

• A Taste of Shela: For an incredible coffee or a delicious meal out, Peponi Hotel is right on our doorstep. For an authentic taste of Swahili cuisine at home, ask Chef George to prepare his specialty—a fragrant chicken or beef biriyani. It's Millicent's personal favorite!

• Practical Tips for First-Timers: Lamu is home to well-known banks for currency exchange, and mobile payment (M-Pesa) is widely accepted. Most importantly, you will find the people of Lamu to be incredibly warm, welcoming, and always ready to help.

-----------------------------------------------

-> ISLAND LIFE: Shela is a unique, peaceful village with no cars. The main sounds are the gentle call to prayer from the nearby mosque, the laughter of children, and the ocean breeze. It's all part of the authentic charm.

------------------------------------------------

-> STAY CONNECTED: Wi-Fi is available. While it can sometimes be slower than in the city, it's typically sufficient for emails and Browse—though we highly recommend disconnecting and enjoying the moment!

★ Work from Paradise ★
Need to stay connected? We've got you covered. The house is equipped with a reliable Safaricom Wi-Fi connection (50 mbps speed), perfect for handling video calls or sending emails before you switch off and head to the beach.

title: Old Lamu historic house with pool,seaview, toproof
description:
DAR EL EDEN HOUSE is an old 18th century swahili house carefully restaured and expanded in 2009

This coral stone house maintains its original swahili architecture with local traditional materials and tadelakt plaster technique used in Marocco.
Original 3,5 m ceilings and walls are decorated with carved niches , freezes and alcoves .
The 4 levels home with swimming pool ,5 bedrooms suiting up for 12 persons includes a 360 degrees panoramic view on the city and ocean on third floor.

The space
5 in suite bedrooms [ minimum 25 m2] on 3 different levels with hot water powered by solar panels and large bathrooms [ 7 - 10 m2] , including ceilings fans and mosquitos nets .

Handcrafted swahili beds and furnitures made by local artisans , including new matresses and european linens .

Ideal for several couples and large families with bedrooms , kitchenettes , terraces and cushionned sitting areas in 3 different levels facilitating relaxing , calm and privacy.

The construction is taking into account cooling and wind circulation , all rooms and bed rooms have at least 2 sides air openings to capture air breeze .

The decoration is inspired by local swahili, african and arabic cultural elements including historical east african maps and arabic calligraphies.

Ground floor : visitors reception area ,pool , cinema lounge ,kitchenette and one full bed room

First floor : open terrace , main kitchen , double dinning room , saloon , chicha lounge , one full bed room

Second floor : one queen bed room , one king bed room including also a single bed , one king bed room with mezzanine including another full bed , private open or covered terraces for each bedrooms .

Third floor : a 110 m2 top roof terrace with 2 levels : one with makuti tatched roof including kitchenette , hanging and swinging beds and various cushionned areas , another one with open air discreet area for sun bathing .

Wifi and chichas on request .
Cinema lounge with dvd player , english and french library
International movies dvds and east african travel books available on request.

The main kitchen on first floor is self catered , including a gaz cooker , oven , a large freeze with freezer independant part , micro wave mini grill and all ustensiles including mixer , blender , coffee maker , yogourt maker ice cream maker...
in the fourth floor terrace a bbq grill and a tandoori oven are available for meat and fish lovers .

Guest access
.All parts of the house are accessible except the storage area .
.Self catering but including our house keeper Mbogo who is available for meals cooking and shopping with expenditures record when available .
.A second house keeper will be included with a minimum of 7 guests in the house .
.Meals can be served on the first floor dining room or on the top roof terrace.

Other things to note
the house must be rented for 4 days minimum during the christmas / new year period in high season [december 22th to january 6th]

title:
Green room at 
Ndege Beach House with pool
description:
Our house is a small boutique hotel with a swimming pool on a pristine beach. The house is very stylishly decorated with a mix of modern and African art. You can enjoy the view on a beach bed at the front or relax on a bed by the pool. We have multiple lounge areas, seating and dining areas and terraces. Enjoy the stars, the sun, the moon, the sea and the wind barefoot. This is truly home away from home! Our warm staff takes good care of the guests.

Guest access
As a guest, you can use all the common areas outside and on the ground floor in the house.
We have a small pool bar with lounge spot, two sunnies and for you can lie on the beach front.
We are retreating to the 1st floor.

During your stay
Call or WhatsApp, or just a conversation. I am basically always present, unless I am on the road with a medical camp. But then I always have Starlink with me.

Other things to note
Boat transfers are not included. Give us your flight number and arrival time, and we will pick you up in our own boat. We charge 1,500 Ksh euros for a one-way trip. From Lamu Town it also costs 1,500 Ksh and to Shela is 500 Ksh.

We have a chef in the house so cooking ourselves in our kitchen is not the intention.

We live on the beach with beautiful birds; loud music on tree boxes or parties is not appreciated by us.

The house is really for lovers of peace and relaxation!

title: JamboHouse Lamu - external bathroom, ground floor
description:
JamboHouse Lamu is a small guesthouse in Lamu Town. We are not a 5 star resort - we offer budget accommodation with clean rooms and lots of information to make your stay in Lamu as good as possible. We have 3 rooms with integrated bathroom and 2 rooms with private external bathroom. Our delicious breakfast is already included. We have free wifi internet for our guests and during the day free coffee/tea. On arrival we serve a Welcome Drink, give a map of Lamu and plenty of useful information.

The space
JamboHouse Lamu is located on one of the highest places in town. From our Top Roof guests have a nice view of Lamu Town, can see sunrise and in certain times of the year also sunset. JamboHouse Lamu is located three minutes walking from Lamu Fort, five minutes walking from Lamu Museum. The closest (local) shop is just 50 m away.

This room is located on the ground floor and has a private bathroom via the corridor (5 meters from the room).

N E W @ JamboHouse Lamu
In case of a power blackout, we have back up batteries in each room.
Stand fans/tower fans can ran for up to 11 hours. Guests can also charge laptops or phones.

During your stay
I also stay in the same house so more or less I'm always available. Guests can also reach me by phone. My staff is also around till at least lunch time (till they are finishing work).

title: Ttunu House
description:
Ttunu House is situated in Lamu Town, a world heritage site, with views over the Manda Channel and the town’s sky line. The house has been recently and beautifully renovated, combining of authentic Swahili methods of construction with modern details. Ttunu House is a historic, merchant’s town mansion dating from 1740. Historic detailing mixes with modern luxury. Beautiful patios and roof terraces let you enjoy the breeze, the sun, and the stars. An oasis of tranquillity in the heart of Lamu.

The space
Ttunu is a large house spread over four floors, including the roof terrace. It has two double bedrooms of the first floor and one double and one twin bedroom on the second floor. All bedrooms have ensuite bathrooms.
There is one dinning area next to the pool on the ground flour and another one on the first floor. Each dinning area comfortably sits 10.
There are sitting areas throughout the house with lots of space on the roof to sit and enjoy the breeze and view.

Guest access
Guests have access to all areas within the house and garden.

Other things to note
Ttunu House has a staff of three, including a full-time chef, whose services are included in the hire of the property. Guests are encouraged to discuss the day's menu with the chef at breakfast time. The chef will then visit the markets to buy fresh produce and prepare lunch and/or dinner as required. Guests will be charged for the produce purchased either daily or at the end of their stay, whichever is preferred. Rooms will be cleaned and laundry done by the house staff on a daily basis.
